meta.description: Build source-grounded deep-reading Paper Card for one scientific paper with fixed Sections 01-16 covering bibliographic position, research question, background route, pain point, core insight, method/module logic, essential formulas, experiment-to-claim evidence, conclusion boundaries, author-stated limitations, critical analysis, learned knowledge, knowledge connections, and testable research ideas. Enforces evidence grounding with bundled scripts (prepare_paper.py, audit_paper_card.py) and locator modes (page-grounded, structure-grounded, source-limited).

scientific_integrity.detail: Evidence grounding enforced: claim-evidence matrix required, numerical results must match source, author statements separated from agent analysis. Groundedness QA (audit_paper_card.py) mandatory before delivery. No fabricated page numbers in fallback modes.

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for deep single-paper analysis. Separates external field-history verification from paper's own narrative. Research ideas marked as hypotheses (not novelty claims). Does not cross into full peer review, translation, or batch monitoring.

methodological_ground.detail: Claim-evidence matrix methodology sound. Experiment-to-claim evidence chain reconstructs argument logic. Locator state machine (page-grounded/structure-grounded/source-limited) maintains transparency about source availability.

code_usability.detail: Bundled scripts (prepare_paper.py for PDF extraction, audit_paper_card.py for groundedness QA) provided. Fixed Sections 01-16 schema documented. Paper-type fragments for six domains (methods, discovery, resource, clinical, materials, review).

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive deep-reading workflow: fixed Sections 01-16 covering all aspects from bibliographic position to testable research ideas. Evidence inventory, claim-evidence matrix, method/module analysis, experiment-to-claim chain, conclusion boundaries, critical analysis. Six paper-type fragments (methods, discovery, resource, clinical, materials, review). Bundled PDF extraction and groundedness auditing.

reliability.note: Excellent quality gates: mandatory groundedness QA (audit_paper_card.py), claim-evidence matrix before drafting, evidence inventory covering all figures/tables, numerical results verification, locator mode state machine prevents fabrication. Script red lines enforce bundled scripts (no inline replacements).

performance_context.note: Efficient evidence-first approach: inventory and matrix before drafting prevents multiple passes. Progressive reference loading (evidence-and-provenance.md, card-schema.md, research-idea-gates.md on-demand). Locator modes adapt to source availability.

agent_usability.note: Excellent routing protocol: 6-step workflow with clear gates. Paper-type classification by evidence logic (not discipline label). Locator state machine explicit (page-grounded/structure-grounded/source-limited). Script resolution relative to SKILL_DIR prevents path confusion. Evidence-and-provenance separation clear.

human_usability.note: Strong output contract: fixed Sections 01-16 structure consistent across papers. Language localization (match user's language, preserve technical terms). Relationship to adjacent skills clearly documented (nature-reader, nature-academic-search, nature-reviewer). Bilingual triggers (深度阅读文献卡).

security.note: Excellent script safety: bundled scripts resolved relative to SKILL_DIR (not user CWD), replacement scripts forbidden during normal runs, no inline Python execution. Locator modes prevent fabricated page numbers. External search limited to specific sections (04, 15, bibliographic verification).

maintainability.note: Excellent modular design: core principles/workflow/output-contract, paper-type fragments (6 types with multi-select for hybrids), on-demand references. Bundled quality tools (prepare_paper.py, audit_paper_card.py) versioned with skill. Clear extension points for new paper types.

agent_specific.note: Strong evidence-grounding workflow: claim-evidence matrix, inventory before drafting. Locator state machine sophisticated. Groundedness auditor integration excellent. Minor: no explicit token budget management for very long papers (100+ pages). Research-idea gates documented but could benefit from automatic feasibility scoring. No nature-reader artifact reuse optimization (avoid re-extraction when artifact exists).

key_strengths: Exceptional evidence-grounding workflow: mandatory claim-evidence matrix before drafting, groundedness auditor (audit_paper_card.py) catches fabrications, numerical results verification
Sophisticated locator state machine: page-grounded/structure-grounded/source-limited modes maintain transparency about source availability and prevent fabricated citations
Excellent script safety: bundled scripts resolved relative to SKILL_DIR, replacement scripts forbidden during normal runs, no inline Python execution
Strong modular design: core principles/workflow/output-contract stable, six paper-type fragments with hybrid support (multi-select), fixed Sections 01-16 output contract
Robust quality gates: evidence inventory and claim-evidence matrix before drafting, separation of author statements from agent analysis, research ideas marked as hypotheses

recommendations.title: Add token budget management for very long papers
recommendations.problem: Deep-reading workflow (evidence inventory, claim-evidence matrix, full method analysis, all experiments) can exceed context limits for very long papers (100+ pages with extensive supplements). No explicit guidance for chunking or prioritization.
recommendations.root_cause: Workflow assumes full-paper processing fits in context. No length-adaptive strategy documented.
recommendations.fix: Add references/long-paper-strategy.md with: (1) page count threshold (>80 pages triggers chunked mode), (2) priority-based evidence inventory (main figures/tables first, supplements optional), (3) incremental claim-evidence matrix (core claims → all claims), (4) token budget estimation (1k per page baseline + 5k per figure/table). Document in workflow step 2 as conditional strategy.

recommendations.title: Add quantitative feasibility scoring for research ideas
recommendations.problem: Section 16 research ideas assessed qualitatively ('feasible with moderate effort') but lack quantitative scoring for prioritization. Users cannot easily rank 3-5 ideas by implementation difficulty, novelty, or expected impact.
recommendations.root_cause: research-idea-gates.md provides hypothesis/novelty distinction but no feasibility rubric.
recommendations.fix: Add to research-idea-gates.md: (1) 3-dimension scoring (data availability 1-5, method complexity 1-5, resource requirements 1-5), (2) composite feasibility score (max 15), (3) expected impact qualitative (incremental/substantial/transformative), (4) prioritization matrix (high-feasibility + substantial-impact = priority 1). Include scoring template in Section 16 output.

recommendations.title: Add nature-reader artifact reuse optimization
recommendations.problem: Routing protocol says 'prefer existing nature-reader artifact when supplied' but lacks explicit optimization: if artifact exists with full extraction, should skip prepare_paper.py entirely and use artifact's source map directly to save processing time.
recommendations.root_cause: Preference stated but not operationalized. prepare_paper.py may re-extract even when complete artifact available.
recommendations.fix: Add artifact-reuse-protocol.md: (1) detect nature-reader artifact with complete extraction (pages, figures, tables, equations all present), (2) skip prepare_paper.py and use artifact source map directly, (3) validate artifact freshness (created from same PDF version), (4) fall back to prepare_paper.py only if artifact incomplete or stale. Update routing protocol step 2 with reuse decision tree.
